regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and aggregate claims for cobalt-catalyzed C8 dienylation, NaF dependence, alkenylation, scale-up, and mechanistic studies. The abstract is summary evidence and does not create duplicate experiments.
Classified generic allene 1,2-/2,3-insertion and termination pathways as prior/conceptual chemistry; Int-I/Int-II are not current isolated preparations.

Separated cited cobalt alkenylation/annulation examples from the present generic C8-dienylation design and proposed Co-allyl pathway. Prior arrows were not promoted to current-paper experiments; the current generic arrow has no experiment-specific yield.

unresolved: Generic R/LG groups and proposed intermediates do not define unique experiment-specific structures or quantities.
The publisher's Supporting Information link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper and middle two-column rationale/results prose
regions.finding: Classified cited prior cobalt/transition-metal chemistry as context and mapped the leaving-group/condition discussions to Scheme 2 and Table 1 without prose duplicates.

Recorded five distinct 1a+allene leaving-group experiments (2-6): OH 20%, OAc 41%, OCOPh 46%, OCO2Me 54%, and OBoc 55%. Carbonate 5/54% is merged with identical Table 1 entry 1 rather than duplicated.
